actions.label: Send email
actions.description: Request sending one identified message to one exact recipient. Additional recipients require separately declared scope.
definitionNotes: Recipient, sender, message, and every attachment are material to the request.
All To, Cc, and Bcc recipients must be declared; this first definition permits one recipient total.
The trusted adapter must verify exactly one effective delivery-envelope recipient matches the declared target, validate all recipient-bearing fields, and reject additional or implicit recipients.
The trusted adapter must verify the message and attachment digests against what would be sent.

actions.label: Delete file
actions.description: Request removal of one exact file at its expected version. Does not include recursive directory deletion.
definitionNotes: No implicit recursive deletion, glob expansion, or target normalization.
Trash and permanent deletion are distinct material choices, neither selected by default.

actions.label: Execute file
actions.description: Request one invocation of an identified executable with explicit arguments and an operator-defined execution profile.
definitionNotes: Arguments are structured values, not an interpolated shell command.
The trusted profile must define environment, standard input, timeout, capabilities, and treatment of dynamic dependencies; caller-selected profile names do not establish authority.
Approving an invocation does not establish control over the executable's subsequent effects.

actions.label: Write file
actions.description: Request one create, replace, or append operation on an exact file with identified content and a checked precondition.
definitionNotes: Create requires absence; replace and append require an exact expected file version and digest.
The declared content digest identifies the new content for create/replace and the appended bytes for append.
No implicit rename, directory creation, or additional metadata mutation is included.

actions.label: Read file
actions.description: Request reading the contents of one exact file at an identified version. This definition does not include writing, deleting, executing, or forwarding the contents.
definitionNotes: This first definition reads the whole identified file; ranges or filtered reads require explicit later definitions.
Permission to read does not grant permission to disclose or send the returned contents.

permissionPresets.label: Read only
permissionPresets.description: Prepare read_file grants for operator-selected exact file targets. Creates no global mode or wildcard grant.
